flooding.label: Flooding
flooding.definition: Active water inundation threatening people or property — rising water indoors, submerged roads, flash floods, trapped in floodwater.

electrocution.label: Electrocution / electrical hazard
electrocution.definition: Live electrical exposure — shocks, downed power lines, sparking wires, especially near water.

injury.label: Injury / medical trauma
injury.definition: Physical trauma requiring first aid — bleeding, fractures, head injury, unconsciousness.

snakebite.label: Snakebite
snakebite.definition: Active or recent venomous snake bite requiring antivenom evaluation.
excludes: historical snake stories without active bite

cyclone.label: Cyclone / severe windstorm
cyclone.definition: Cyclone, hurricane, or severe wind event — storm surge, cyclone warnings, extreme winds damaging structures.
includes: roof blown off by cyclone winds

structural_damage.label: Structural collapse
structural_damage.definition: Building or structure failure — collapse, cave-in, people trapped under rubble.

accident.label: Road / vehicle accident
accident.definition: Active traffic collision — vehicles crashed, pedestrian hit, serious road accident.

unclassified.label: Unclassified
unclassified.definition: No confident emergency category — general help requests, tests, historical reports, or ambiguous input.
